# What a user does and sees (compat/apps.rs): each case after its tap.
platform web desktop
fontscale 2
# props-platform-web
tap id:case-props-platform-web
expect Link
# `web={{…}}` wins over the prop set for every platform; `android={{…}}`
# does not apply.
prop id:link accessibilityLabel In a browser
prop id:link elevation 0
prop id:link backdropMaterial ultraThin
covers [props] web
# props-text-scaling
tap id:case-props-text-scaling
# twice the default.
style id:scaled fontSize 20
style id:fixed fontSize 10
style id:capped fontSize 15
style id:field fontSize 20
style id:field-fixed fontSize 10
style id:field-capped fontSize 15
covers [props] allowFontScaling
covers [props] maxFontSizeMultiplier
# props-media-webview-desktop
tap id:case-props-media-webview-desktop
prop id:page src https://example.com/
prop id:page desktop.allowsBackForwardNavigationGestures true
covers [props] desktop.allowsBackForwardNavigationGestures
# base-popups-desktop
tap id:case-base-popups-desktop
# A press outside a popover on a desktop closes it, unless it says not to.
expect StayBody
touch start text:Elsewhere 5 5
touch end
wait 200
expect StayBody
expect Log: none
covers [props] Popover.closeOnPressOutside
# A menu at the right of its trigger, 7 points away, lined up by its end
# but kept 5 points from the top.
tap text:DeskMenu
expect DeskItem
frame parent:parent:text:DeskItem 127 5 90 600
covers [props] Menu.placement
covers [props] Menu.align
covers [props] Menu.offset
covers [props] Menu.margin
# A context menu where the secondary button went down, 3 points below it,
# kept 9 points from the right edge.
event text:RightClickArea onContextMenu pageX=390 pageY=200
expect DeskCopy
frame parent:parent:text:DeskCopy 291 203 90 40
covers [props] ContextMenu.offset
covers [props] ContextMenu.margin
# A tooltip after the pointer rested on its trigger for `delay`, gone when
# the pointer leaves.
event text:SlowTrigger onMouseEnter
wait 1000
absent SlowTip
wait 1500
expect SlowTip
expect Log: tooltip true hover
expect Tip: open
event text:SlowTrigger onMouseLeave
absent SlowTip
expect Log: tooltip false hover
expect Tip: closed
covers [props] Tooltip.delay
covers [events] Tooltip.onOpenChange
covers [events] Tooltip.onOpen
covers [events] Tooltip.onClose
# An element's `tooltip`: shown after half a second, gone on a press, and
# gone when the pointer leaves.
event id:prop-tip onMouseEnter
wait 700
expect PropTip
touch start id:prop-tip 5 5
touch end
absent PropTip
event text:ElementTrigger onMouseEnter
wait 700
expect ElementTip
event text:ElementTrigger onMouseLeave
absent ElementTip
covers [props] tooltip
# base-popup-looks
tap id:case-base-popup-looks
# A popover is made with its starting looks and takes its own from its
# first frame on; it says the side it went on.
tap text:PopTrigger
expect PopBody
style parent:text:PopBody opacity 0
style parent:text:PopBody backgroundColor #ff0000ff
expect Side: popover bottom 40
wait 100
nostyle parent:text:PopBody opacity
nostyle parent:text:PopBody backgroundColor
# Closed, it stays with its ending looks through its 300 ms; then it is
# gone and closed.
tap text:PopTrigger
style parent:text:PopBody opacity 0.5
style parent:text:PopBody backgroundColor #0000ffff
expect PopBody
expect Life: popover open
wait 500
absent PopBody
expect Life: popover closed
covers [props] Popover.popupStartingClass
covers [props] Popover.popupStartingStyle
covers [props] Popover.popupEndingClass
covers [props] Popover.popupEndingStyle
covers [events] Popover.onPosition
# A menu and its submenu, the same.
tap text:MenuTrigger
expect MenuNew
style parent:parent:text:MenuNew opacity 0
style parent:parent:text:MenuNew backgroundColor #ff0000ff
expect Side: menu bottom
wait 100
nostyle parent:parent:text:MenuNew opacity
tap text:MenuShare
expect MenuMail
style parent:parent:text:MenuMail opacity 0
wait 100
nostyle parent:parent:text:MenuMail opacity
# Choosing an item closes both, each with its ending looks.
tap text:MenuMail
style parent:parent:text:MenuNew opacity 0.5
style parent:parent:text:MenuNew backgroundColor #0000ffff
style parent:parent:text:MenuMail opacity 0.5
expect MenuNew
wait 500
absent MenuNew
absent MenuMail
expect Life: menu closed
covers [props] Menu.popupStartingClass
covers [props] Menu.popupStartingStyle
covers [props] Menu.popupEndingClass
covers [props] Menu.popupEndingStyle
covers [events] Menu.onPosition
# A context menu, the same.
event text:LooksArea onContextMenu pageX=200 pageY=400
expect CtxCopy
style parent:parent:text:CtxCopy opacity 0
style parent:parent:text:CtxCopy backgroundColor #ff0000ff
expect Side: context bottom
wait 100
nostyle parent:parent:text:CtxCopy opacity
tap text:CtxCopy
style parent:parent:text:CtxCopy opacity 0.5
style parent:parent:text:CtxCopy backgroundColor #0000ffff
wait 500
absent CtxCopy
expect Life: context closed
covers [props] ContextMenu.popupStartingClass
covers [props] ContextMenu.popupStartingStyle
covers [props] ContextMenu.popupEndingClass
covers [props] ContextMenu.popupEndingStyle
covers [events] ContextMenu.onPosition
# A tooltip the app shows and hides, the same.
tap text:TipToggle
expect TipBody
style parent:text:TipBody opacity 0
style parent:text:TipBody backgroundColor #ff0000ff
wait 100
nostyle parent:text:TipBody opacity
tap text:TipToggle
style parent:text:TipBody opacity 0.5
style parent:text:TipBody backgroundColor #0000ffff
wait 500
absent TipBody
expect Life: tooltip closed
covers [props] Tooltip.startingClass
covers [props] Tooltip.startingStyle
covers [props] Tooltip.endingClass
covers [props] Tooltip.endingStyle
# base-select-desktop
tap id:case-base-select-desktop
# A list at the right of its trigger, 7 points away, lined up by its end
# but kept 5 points from the top; its search field takes the keyboard at
# once.
tap text:SideSelect
expect Desk: true triggerPress
expect Kiwi
frame parent:scroll:label:Kiwi 127 5 120 600
prop below:scroll:label:Kiwi autoFocus true
# A press outside closes it.
touch start text:Elsewhere 5 5
touch end
expect Desk: false pressOutside
absent Kiwi
covers [props] Select.placement
covers [props] Select.align
covers [props] Select.offset
covers [props] Select.margin
# Below its trigger by default, lined up by its start: as wide as the
# trigger (150) and as tall as its one row (30).
tap text:WideSelect
expect Lime
frame parent:scroll:label:Lime 20 368 150 30
touch start text:Elsewhere 5 5
touch end
absent Lime

# The browser-JS backend shares the app's brands and preserves queued jobs.
tap id:case-runtime-identities
expect Buffer brand: true
expect Cleanup identity: true
expect Callback error: TypeError
expect Ticks: 0
tap id:runtime-tick
wait 20
expect Ticks: 1
